CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_record_auth_reconciliation(p_operation text, p_auth_user_id uuid, p_target_username text, p_last_error text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  caller record;
BEGIN
  -- We assume this is called by Vercel API via service_role key or user key.
  -- Wait, if it's called by service_role key, auth.uid() is null!
  -- We'll allow it if called with service_role bypass. But since it's an RPC, 
  -- service_role can call it. If auth.uid() is null, it's service role.
  IF auth.role() != 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only service_role can record auth reconciliation' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.auth_reconciliation (
    business_id, operation, auth_user_id, target_username, last_error
  ) 
  -- We need business_id. Find it from the target username, or fallback.
  SELECT business_id, p_operation, p_auth_user_id, p_target_username, p_last_error
  FROM public.staff 
  WHERE username = p_target_username 
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$
